Class AttributeBeanSearch

java.lang.Object
javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.TagSupport
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.view.general.AttributeBeanSearch
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.IterationTag, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.JspTag, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag
@Deprecated public class AttributeBeanSearch extends javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.TagSupport
Deprecated.
Use something like "displaytable" tag for the same.
This class implements a JSP Tag whose main objective is to take a Collection of AttributedModelBean and display them in a table using some supplied parameters.
Version:
0.1.0
Author:
Daniel Varela Santoalla

    • doStartTag

      public int doStartTag() throws javax.servlet.jsp.JspTagException
      Deprecated.
      Hook method called by the taglib container at the start of the tag. Access the DAOService to retrieve a vector of the Bean instances, filtered by the filter. Then print the info using the configurable values set by the attributes.
      Specified by:
      doStartTag in interface javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag
      Overrides:
      doStartTag in class javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.TagSupport
      Returns:
      SKIP_BODY, since this tag has no body.
      Throws:
      javax.servlet.jsp.JspTagException
